notes: Exercises the author's four hand-written utility macros (section 3, lines ~133-164, unmodified): %tri (sort), %QL (PROC FREQ descriptive stats for a qualitative variable), %svg (save a table into a named library) and %supp (PROC DELETE a work table), plus the TYPEG tumour-group format the program defines in section 1 (proc format, lines ~78-90). Driven end-to-end (sort -> describe -> save -> delete) against a 10-row mock patient table (id, typeg, sex) standing in for the protected cohort extract these macros are called against throughout the original ~1800-line program.
